performance.verdict: Spend is live but attribution is broken; 10 conversions invisible to CRM.

findings.text: lead_drought flag: 0 leads recorded across 28 days despite 10 Google Ads conversions logged — confirmed tracking disconnect, not zero demand.
Overdue SOW milestone: Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 — no completion event recorded; speed-to-lead promise unverified with intake owner also unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7.
GHL shows 51 opportunities created and 20 won in 28 days against $0 recorded CPL — pipeline has activity but zero-dollar opportunity values and 0 appointments mean intake data quality is unreliable.
Spend pattern is erratic: 7 zero-spend days in 28, daily Google spend ranging $0–$130.18, averaging only $14.99/day this week — suggests budget cap or billing disruption, not intentional throttle.
GBP actions dropped 50% week-over-week to an implied ~4/day; last 3 days (Aug 28–30) show 1, 0, 0 actions — organic demand signal fading alongside paid drop.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion action against GHL: reconcile 10 logged conversions to 0 CRM leads — fix tracking or intake routing this week.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads recorded 10 conversions in the 28-day window but GHL shows 0 leads and 0 appointments — these must refer to real contacts somewhere. Pull the Google Ads conversion action source, verify it fires on the correct thank-you or call event, and trace whether the 51 GHL opportunities originated from those clicks or from LSA/organic. Success = every Google Ads conversion matched to a GHL contact by 2026-09-05. If a seat is empty (Vivian left 7/7), confirm who owns GHL intake before re-enabling any speed-to-lead automation.

suggestions.text: Battle-test booking bot immediately: overdue since 2026-07-31; confirm GHL seat owner and after-hours coverage before any budget increase.
suggestions.monday_update: The booking bot battle-test milestone was due 2026-07-31 and has no recorded completion. With Vivian gone since 7/7, the GHL seat automations point to may be unmanned. Run a full end-to-end test call and form submission through the bot, confirm a live person or automation catches after-hours leads, and document who owns the GHL login now. Success = documented test pass with named intake owner confirmed by 2026-09-05. This is a hard gate on any spend scale-up per the SOW.

suggestions.text: Watch daily Google spend: 7 zero-spend days and $14.99/day average suggest a billing or cap issue — confirm before attributing to intentional throttle.

Verify the campaign budget cap settings and confirm the Meta billing card update (Nader's old Amex → Visa/Chase, noted 6/11) did not also affect Google billing credentials.
